ratings.note: Configurable power×speed grid (ADR-044), burned numeric labels, normal Scene pipeline; two axes only vs LightBurn's six; code-only, unrendered.
Reference generator: 6-param dropdown, 10×10 default, min/max, separate material/text/border settings, preset export. Roster's most flexible.
N/R: CNC-only per binding Phase-0 note; power×speed grids are a laser feature absent from MillMage's CNC operation set.
No in-app generator; testing done by importing fixed downloadable grid files or generating in LightBurn/online tools.
Material Test Array: power×speed, adjustable min/max/count/spacing, editable header labels, vector+bitmap; solid two-axis, fewer axes than LightBurn.
CNC; no power×speed grid generator (inferred absent). Offers a feeds/speeds calculator and tested defaults, not a test grid.
No test-grid generator; open forum feature request asks for a LightBurn-style N×M grid; users script external Python.
Interval Test functional (1-20 steps, burned labels); Focus Test permanently disabled stub (no Z-motion generator); bonus scan-offset generator.
Two dedicated generators: Interval Test and Focus Test (Z ramp: start/end Z, steps, speed, max power). Roster-leading.
N/R: CNC-only per binding note; interval/focus tests are laser concepts with no MillMage equivalent.
No in-app interval or focus generator; provides fixed downloadable Depth-of-Focus and accuracy test files to import and run.
No interval-test or focus-ramp generator; focus handled by autofocus/manual measurement plus downloadable focus files.
CNC; interval/focus are laser concepts, absent (inferred). Z handled by Z-probe zeroing, not a focus ramp.
CNC; no interval or focus-ramp generator (inferred absent). Toolpath set is contour/pocket/drill/V-carve.
Numeric fields plus safety clamps (power 0-100, floors); labels auto numeric-only (7-seg, no titles); fixed axes, no param choice.
Highly customizable: text-label and border toggles, per-axis param choice (6), min/max/count, rect H/W, absolute positioning, preset save/export.
N/R: CNC-only; no laser material-test generator, so no customization surface to rate.
No generator to customize; downloadable test files are fixed artifacts, editable only externally.
Customizable within power/speed: min/max, count, spacing, editable header/title, per-element editing; no interval/passes axes, no border toggle or caps.
No material-test generator, so no customization controls; cut settings edited per-toolpath (inferred).
No material-test generator to customize; the requested LightBurn-style grid tool does not exist (open feature request).
Full scan-offset round-trip writes profile; but power×speed/interval→preset path removed (ADR-047), leaving manual wizard re-entry only.
Manual round-trip: apply best cell to layer, 'Create new from layer' saves to Material Library (name/thickness/desc). Auto-save still requested.
N/R: CNC-only; no laser material-test flow, so no test-result-to-saved-material round-trip.
No material library; chosen speed/power transcribed manually into engrave params or G-code each time.
Manual round-trip: a winning Material Test Array cell's power/speed can be saved as a user-defined material; no one-click save.
Has Inventables-tested default cut settings and a feeds/speeds calculator, but no in-app test result saves back to a material.
Tool library associates feeds/speeds with tool+material, but no material test feeds it — no test-result round-trip.

wins.claim: KerfDesk generates a configurable power×speed material-test grid in-app; Carbide Create has none (open feature request; users script external Python).
KerfDesk generates power×speed grids in-app; LaserGRBL can only import and run fixed downloadable test files.
KerfDesk ships a working interval-test generator; LaserGRBL only runs downloadable focus/accuracy files, generating nothing in-app.

gaps.claim: KerfDesk's Focus Test is a permanently-disabled stub (no Z-motion generator); LightBurn ships a working Z-ramp Focus Test.
No automated path from a power×speed test cell to a saved material preset (removed per ADR-047); LightBurn and XCS save a winning cell's settings.
KerfDesk's grid varies only power×speed; LightBurn varies six parameters including interval and passes.
KerfDesk labels are auto numeric-only (7-segment, no titles/text); LightBurn and XCS support editable text labels.
